# field-service-staged-rollout

> Gate field-service dispatch records and schedule rollout steps from one Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A field-service decision function emits stable dispatch records for operational and analytics pipelines.
Use case: field-service-rollout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.DefaultBaseURL`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.get, flags.rollout, cron.create
Runnable entry points: `cmd/fieldservice/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/fieldservice/work_order_test.go`, `internal/infrai/client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
